Build clean, exit 0.

Real bug: `settings.js:17` reference undefined var `retries` instead of `env.retries`, crashing link stage every time. Fixed: `maxRetries: env.retries != null ? env.retries : 3`. 3 warnings remain (deprecated crypto API, unused export, circular import) — cosmetic, not build-breaking. Say word if want those cleared too.
